NCS Neuromonitoring

NCS is committed to providing hospitals, surgeons, and patients a best-in-class IONM experience. NCS
combines industry-leading technology, service, and quality to serve over 100,000 cases annually. Our
team of board-certified neurologists and neurophysiologists are highly trained professionals aiming
to provide the highest-quality intraoperative neuromonitoring service possible and is supported by
an industry-leading training and educational program.

## [Surgical Navigation][84]

The 7D FLASH™ Navigation System revolutionizes surgical precision by combining unmatched accuracy,
efficient workflow and a reduced to completely radiation-free experience. Its machine-vision
technology rapidly captures and reconstructs a highly detailed 3D image, ensuring precise
navigation. FLASH Registration streamlines workflow, reducing patient registration time from 30
minutes to as little as 30 seconds, allowing surgeons to focus entirely on the patient rather than
cumbersome technology. With a fully sterile-field-controlled interface, the system eliminates
reliance on additional staff, enhancing surgical autonomy and efficiency. By delivering superior
accuracy with a seamless workflow, 7D FLASH Navigation empowers surgeons to operate with confidence
while prioritizing patient safety — and continues to innovate boldly, redefining the future of
surgical navigation.

[Spine Navigation System][85] | [Cranial Navigation System][86]
[7D FLASH EVD][87]

## [Therapeutic Solutions][88]

Orthofix Therapeutic Solutions are redefining recovery through a diverse, coordinated portfolio that
brings together non-invasive bone growth therapies, bracing solutions, and dedicated patient support
through a single, trusted partner. Our approach streamlines access to multiple recovery tools,
creating a more seamless experience for providers and patients. With decades of experience
supporting recovery pathways and a legacy grounded in clinical evidence, Orthofix Therapeutic
Solutions are designed to help keep patients engaged and supported throughout their healing journey.

[Bone Growth Therapies][89] | [Bracing Solutions][90]

We hold proprietary expertise in 3D printing of osseointegrative materials, AI-based planning and
design automation tools, and digital health solutions to provide seamless data-backed care to
optimize individual patient outcomes. Our solutions are as unique as the patients and surgeons we
assist — because one size doesn’t fit all. 

[Healthcare Professionals][26][Patients][27]

innovative new ways. Each product is expertly designed based on scientific research and manufactured
using the latest advanced technology. 

## Personalized Precision 

restor3d delivers patient-specific 3D-printed implants, tailored to each individual’s anatomy,
ensuring better fit, function, and surgical outcomes.  

## Enabling Technologies 

Combining advanced 3D printing, AI-driven design, and digital health solutions, restor3d leads
personalized musculoskeletal reconstruction with efficient, scalable care. 

## Unmatched Expertise 

Restor3d operates on a data first approach to enhance implant architecture with expertise in
osseointegrative biomaterials.

Achieve superior anatomical fit to repair and restore patients based on their unique anatomy with
tools for pre-surgical planning, precise cut and implant placement.

# Transforming Healthcare with Personalized 3D-Printed Implants 

We hold proprietary expertise in 3D printing of osseointegrative materials, AI-based planning and
design automation tools, and digital health solutions to provide seamless data-backed care to
optimize individual patient outcomes. Our solutions are as unique as the patients and surgeons we
assist — because one size doesn’t fit all. 

[Healthcare Professionals][26][Patients][27]
[ Play Video ][28]

Our personalized 3D printed orthopaedic implants enable surgeons to repair the human body in
innovative new ways. Each product is expertly designed based on scientific research and manufactured
using the latest advanced technology. 

## Personalized Precision 

restor3d delivers patient-specific 3D-printed implants, tailored to each individual’s anatomy,
ensuring better fit, function, and surgical outcomes.  

## Enabling Technologies 

Combining advanced 3D printing, AI-driven design, and digital health solutions, restor3d leads
personalized musculoskeletal reconstruction with efficient, scalable care. 

## Unmatched Expertise 

Restor3d operates on a data first approach to enhance implant architecture with expertise in
osseointegrative biomaterials. 

Healthcare Professionals

## Our Technology is Elevating Orthopaedic Surgery 

Achieve superior anatomical fit to repair and restore patients based on their unique anatomy with
tools for pre-surgical planning, precise cut and implant placement. 

[Healthcare Professionals][29]

### Foot and Ankle

Scientifically developed foot & ankle solutions for Total Ankle Replacement and beyond. 

### Knee 

Personalized total knee solutions to ensure patient satisfaction and mobility. 

### Hip

Total hip personalization offers patient specific planning and personalized instrumentation. 

#### Personalized devices are designed to match your unique anatomy.  

[Patients][30]

Our Mission

## Every patient deserves personalized care 

At restor3d, we understand that the patient’s journey extends far beyond the operating room. It
encompasses every aspect of care, from the initial consultation to post-operative recovery. That’s
why we are dedicated to creating personalized, 3D-printed implants that not only meet the unique
anatomical needs of each patient but also enhance overall post-operative experience. By putting the
patient at the heart of everything we do, we ensure that every step of their journey is as seamless
and supportive as possible.

THE POWER

THE POWER
TO WIN

 GDLS BRAND FILM

**We Serve Those Who Protect What Matters.**

A trusted partner of forces around the world, we deliver with agility, innovation and exceptional
customer support. Every day, our global team forges ahead into the next era of combat capability,
including autonomy-ready platforms, modern digital architecture and AI-enabled advantages.

That’s why Soldiers and Marines have trusted General Dynamics Land Systems products in the toughest
conditions for decades. We deliver the power to win.

[ Learn More ][36]

### ABOUT GDLS

General Dynamics Land Systems builds the combat vehicles and integrated technologies that give
soldiers a decisive advantage. We design, engineer and sustain advanced tracked and wheeled systems
paired with modern electronic architecture, AI-enabled capabilities and autonomy-ready technology.

From Abrams to LAV, Stryker to AJAX, robotic platforms to software solutions and beyond, our
portfolio delivers proven performance and future-ready modernization for customers around the world.

### Not a career.
### A calling.

Join the people who design, build and advance the systems that protect those who protect us. Our
teams see beyond the horizon, solving problems before they become challenges.

Bring your talent. Bring your purpose.

Let’s shape the future of General Dynamics Land Systems together.

Each Step We Care
At United Orthopedic, we provide superior service to our surgeon customers by being more responsive,
agile, and versatile. We listen to surgeons carefully and are uniquely able to meet their unmet
needs through a vertically integrated manufacturing process that allows us to control every critical
step of the process in order to bring our products to market more efficiently. For over 25 years,
United has built a reputation for caring about surgeons, other health care providers, and patients
around the world with a broad portfolio of safe, reliable products designed and produced with care
at every step.
[ About United ][37]

### Patients

We show that we care about our patients by continuously improving our product development and
manufacturing processes in order to deliver high quality surgical solutions.

[Surgeons icon]

### Surgeon Customers

We show that we care about our surgeon customers by carefully listening to their needs and quickly
delivering solutions to assist them in achieving successful clinical outcomes.

### Healthcare Partners

We show that we care about our healthcare partners by providing versatile, cost-effective product
options which are designed to deliver effective surgical solutions.

### World-Class Quality Driven By Vertically-Integrated Manufacturing

United Orthopedic is committed to manufacturing and distributing products of high quality, as well
as ensuring the same high quality in the service and support that we provide to our customers. Our
integrated manufacturing process enables our engineers to design, develop, and manufacture
feature-rich medical device products that deliver clinical success with high-value surgical
solutions that benefit hospitals, surgeons and their patients.

#### portfolio of stem and cup products from bone stock preservation to complex revision
#### arthroplasty.

## Knee System

#### Provides surgeons with innovative designs and a comprehensive suite of implant options to
#### accommodate a wide variety of bone conditions within primary, revision and more complex
#### surgical cases.

## Limb Salvage

#### Offers surgeons a simpler solution for complex salvage cases through its innovative mechanisms
#### and modular design.

## Innovation Pipelines

#### Engineering novel and award winning instruments have been designed to help enhance surgical
#### efficiency, reduce surgical complexities and create valuable benefits to hospitals and surgeons
#### without sacrificing patient outcomes and overall service quality.

Mako Robotic-arm Assisted Technology for Hip & Knee Replacement Surgery

The Mako Robotic-Arm Assisted Technology helps your surgeon create a 3D model of your knee or hip,
which can be used to develop a highly precise surgical plan to ensure accurate placement of the
implant within the joint ensuring a long lasting and well-fitting prosthesis.

Am I Candidate for Robotic-Assisted Surgery?
You may be a candidate if you have:
* Osteoarthritis of the knee
* Degenerative joint disease of the hip
* Loss of joint function
* No relief from conservative care

benefits of the medial-pivot design⁵, resulting in optimal stability.⁶

## WELCOME TO ORTHO CARE

As leading manufacturers of orthopedic products, ORTHO CARE is at the forefront of innovation and
quality in the industry. Established in 1994 and based in Kirti Nagar Industrial Area, New Delhi, we
are committed to delivering superior solutions that enhance patient outcomes and support healthcare
professionals. Our extensive product range includes bone screws, bone plates, interlocking nails,
spinal implants, hip prosthesis, arthroscopy tools, power tools, and external fixators. Each product
is engineered with precision and crafted using state-of-the-art technology, ensuring exceptional
performance and reliability.

We are proud to be a USFDA 510K Cleared and CE certified company, adhering to the highest
international standards. Our compliance with ISO 13485 standards underscores our dedication to
excellence and quality assurance. At ORTHO CARE, our mission is to provide innovative orthopedic
solutions that meet the diverse needs of our clients. With a focus on quality, customer
satisfaction, and continuous improvement, we stand as a trusted partner in advancing orthopedic
care.

[From Wheels to Heels]

## OUR PRODUCT RANGE

Explore our comprehensive range of precision-engineered orthopedic implants and instruments.

[ [Locking Plate Orthopedic Implant]

##### Locking Plate

Locking plates are anatomically contoured orthopedic implants designed to provide angular stability
in complex and osteoporotic fractures. The fixed-angle construct enhances fixation strength,
minimizes screw loosening, and supports early mobilization.

][37] [ [Orthopedic Bone Screw]

##### Bone Screw

Bone screws are high-strength orthopedic fixation devices manufactured for optimal thread engagement
and pull-out resistance. They provide secure fixation across trauma, reconstructive, and spinal
applications.

][38] [ [Interlocking Plate Implant]

##### Interlocking Plate

Interlocking plates offer rigid internal fixation by combining plate stability with interlocking
screw technology. They ensure accurate fracture alignment, load sharing, and reliable healing in
long bone fractures.

][39] [ [Spine Implant System]

##### Spine Implant

Spine implants are precision-engineered systems used for spinal stabilization, correction, and
fusion procedures. Designed to restore spinal alignment and biomechanical stability, they meet
international standards for safety and performance.

][40] [ [Maxillofacial Implant System]

##### Maxillofacial Implants

Maxillofacial implants are specialized fixation systems designed for craniofacial trauma and
reconstructive surgery. They ensure anatomical accuracy, stable fixation, and reliable functional
and aesthetic outcomes.

][41] [ [Neuro Plating System]

##### Neuro Plating System

Neuro plating systems are low-profile fixation solutions used in cranial and neurosurgical
procedures. They provide precise stabilization while minimizing tissue irritation and supporting
safe postoperative recovery.

][42] [ [Hip Prosthesis Implant]

##### Hip Prosthesis

Hip prosthesis systems are designed for partial and total hip replacement procedures, offering
excellent biomechanical compatibility, wear resistance, and long-term joint stability to restore
patient mobility.

][43] [ [Arthroscopy Instruments]

##### Arthroscopy Instruments

Arthroscopy instruments are designed for minimally invasive joint surgeries, enabling accurate
diagnosis and treatment with reduced tissue trauma, faster recovery, and improved surgical
precision.

][44] [ [Hand Implants]

##### Hand Implants

Hand implants are anatomically designed fixation systems used for fractures and reconstructive
procedures of the hand. They support precise alignment, stable fixation, and restoration of fine
motor function.

Osteora implements comprehensive quality assurance systems, including ISO 13485 compliance,
in-process inspection, and final random sampling testing — ensuring every device meets clinical
performance requirements before it reaches the operating room.

Our quality control process encompasses dimensional measurement, mechanical fatigue testing, and
biocompatibility validation. The quality control team consists of **42 specialized inspectors**
ensuring strict adherence to international medical device standards, with 2 dedicated inspectors

clinical load cycles.
🧬
Biocompatibility & Material Validation

biocompatibility standards.
🔍
Final Random Sampling Inspection
Two dedicated final inspectors conduct AQL-based random sampling on every production batch before
shipment approval.

About US

# Delivering Excellence in Healthcare Since 1994

From humble beginnings to building an empire, Shalby Ltd. is a story of commitment towards providing
the best in healthcare. What began as a small orthopedic centre in 1994 with six beds, one operation
theatre, and a small staff, is today a chain of 16 hospitals present in 13 Indian cities across 8
states. The group also encompasses diverse business verticals, all dedicated towards transforming
the medical landscape of India.

the medical landscape of India.

## National Class Action & Trial Lawyers

Federal and state courts frequently appoint the Firm to leadership positions in large, complex class
action cases. The Firm’s leadership in these matters has helped secure relief for more than **50
million** class members.

Over the past 23 years, Joseph Lyon has represented thousands of clients across all fifty states in
consumer class actions, mass torts, and complex individual claims arising from deceptive business
practices, data privacy violations, defective product designs, and corporate neglect.  

The Firm has consistently represented individuals and families in complex litigation involving
personal injury, economic loss, and environmental harm. Joseph has played a significant role in over
100 consumer class actions, many of which advanced novel legal theories involving digital
surveillance and the misuse of confidential healthcare data for marketing purposes.  

Joe has also served in more than 40 multidistrict product liability litigations, helping to secure
substantial compensation for his clients. Much of this work has helped fuel industry reforms that
resulted in safer pharmaceutical, medical device, and consumer products. Several of these cases rank
among the largest mass tort proceedings in history.

For over 20 years, the Firm has focused on high-impact litigation that promotes positive corporate
change and accountability. Recognized as a national leader in complex litigation, the Firm has a
proven history of exposing dangerous business practices and defective products in industries where
regulatory oversight has lagged, thereby bringing attention to serious consumer risks. The Lyon Firm

models for individual clients and class members. Collectively, the Firm’s work has contributed to
numerous high-profile settlements that have generated over **$800 million** in gross value offered
for consumers, secured more than **$550 million** in recovered value for clients and class members,

## National Class Action & Trial Lawyers

Federal and state courts frequently appoint the Firm to leadership positions in large, complex class
action cases. The Firm’s leadership in these matters has helped secure relief for more than **50
million** class members.

Over the past 23 years, Joseph Lyon has represented thousands of clients across all fifty states in
consumer class actions, mass torts, and complex individual claims arising from deceptive business
practices, data privacy violations, defective product designs, and corporate neglect.  

The Firm has consistently represented individuals and families in complex litigation involving
personal injury, economic loss, and environmental harm. Joseph has played a significant role in over
100 consumer class actions, many of which advanced novel legal theories involving digital
surveillance and the misuse of confidential healthcare data for marketing purposes.  

Joe has also served in more than 40 multidistrict product liability litigations, helping to secure
substantial compensation for his clients. Much of this work has helped fuel industry reforms that
resulted in safer pharmaceutical, medical device, and consumer products. Several of these cases rank
among the largest mass tort proceedings in history.

At United Orthopedic, we provide superior service to our surgeon customers by being more responsive,
agile, and versatile. We listen to surgeons carefully and are uniquely able to meet their unmet
needs through a vertically integrated manufacturing process that allows us to control every critical
step of the process in order to bring our products to market more efficiently. For over 30 years,
United has built a reputation for caring about surgeons, other health care providers, and patients
around the world with a broad portfolio of safe, reliable products designed and produced with care
at every step.

We show that we care about our patients by continuously improving our product development and
manufacturing processes in order to deliver high quality surgical solutions.

delivering solutions to assist them in achieving successful clinical outcomes.

### Healthcare Partners

options which are designed to deliver effective surgical solutions.
